footwork.maintain_message: 維持目前步法節奏，持續強化穩定與回位品質。

serve.maintain_message: 維持目前發球完整度，持續提升穩定與流暢性。

clear.maintain_message: 高遠球目前為優勢項目，可維持技術並持續提升穩定性。

suggested_playing_level.reason: Current V1 contains isolated motion assessments only and does not include rally or match competency evidence.

confidence.reason: Playing-level confidence requires a future evidence-coverage contract.

limitations: V1 coaching recommendations use existing Competency Profile and Competency Interpretation only.
V1 does not re-score motions or calculate a cross-motion overall score.
V1 does not produce an official or suggested playing level from isolated motion assessments.
Future playing-level recommendations require rally or match competency evidence.
Video evidence may be affected by camera angle, lighting, occlusion, blur, frame loss, and incomplete skill coverage.
